description: The Facility List Coder research team publishes Python notebooks for building lists of urban facilities from map-service searches. Its method combines multilingual category keywords with Google Maps and OpenStreetMap queries and illustrates the workflow in Mataró, Spain. The public repository provides the documented implementation, and the describing article explicitly assigns CC BY-SA 4.0 to the shared resource. Source reuse is free; external API quotas or charges can affect execution. These globally adaptable tools can prepare facility inventories for service-access and infrastructure-demand simulations. Search vocabulary, incomplete map coverage and duplicate establishments can bias the output, which requires checking before modelling. Installation and API behaviour were not tested. No directly related catalogue platform was identified.
